items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: then got Charlie and Buster and Procope

ctx.x: And then we went to California. We went to California to work -- went to California to work, at the Famous Door out there, and we stayed there, I think about -- well, we had a little trouble there because nobody liked California. Everybody wanted to go back to New York, you know, so Stuff told me he was putting in the notice, and the guy said, "You can't put in no notice," the manager says. "You've got a six month contract where we can't fire you and you can't leave, you can't quit." So then we said, well, we'd…
but they didn't do too good. They had Leo Watson and Pete Brown and Frankie Newton, and then got Charlie and Buster and Procope. , you know.
